name: 7 Days to Die
description: 7 Days to Die dedicated server. The game port is 26900 by convention (TCP and UDP); the game also uses the game port + 1 and + 2 on UDP, so give the two extra ports those numbers. The variables below override serverconfig.xml on the command line; every other setting in that file is yours to edit. The console is the server's telnet console, which is only reachable from inside the container.
startup_command: export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=.; mkdir -p logs; rm -f logs/latest.log; ./7DaysToDieServer.x86_64 -configfile=serverconfig.xml -logfile logs/latest.log -quit -batchmode -nographics -dedicated -ServerPort={{SERVER_PORT}} -ServerName="${SERVER_NAME}" -ServerPassword="${SERVER_PASSWORD}" -ServerMaxPlayerCount={{MAX_PLAYERS}} -ServerVisibility={{SERVER_VISIBILITY}} -ServerDisabledNetworkProtocols="${SERVER_DISABLED_NETWORK_PROTOCOLS}" -GameWorld="${GAME_WORLD}" -WorldGenSeed="${WORLD_GEN_SEED}" -WorldGenSize={{WORLD_GEN_SIZE}} -GameName="${GAME_NAME}" -GameDifficulty={{GAME_DIFFICULTY}} -ControlPanelEnabled=false -TelnetEnabled=true -TelnetPort={{TELNET_PORT}} -TelnetPassword= & SDTD_PID=$!; tail -n +1 -F logs/latest.log 2>/dev/null & TAIL_PID=$!; echo "[Atlas] Starting 7 Days to Die; the console connects when the server is ready."; until nc -z -w5 127.0.0.1 {{TELNET_PORT}} 2>/dev/null; do if ! kill -0 "${SDTD_PID}" 2>/dev/null; then kill "${TAIL_PID}" 2>/dev/null; echo "[Atlas] 7 Days to Die exited while starting. See logs/latest.log."; exit 1; fi; sleep 5; done; kill "${TAIL_PID}" 2>/dev/null; while kill -0 "${SDTD_PID}" 2>/dev/null; do if nc -z -w2 127.0.0.1 {{TELNET_PORT}} 2>/dev/null; then telnet -E 127.0.0.1 {{TELNET_PORT}}; else sleep 2; fi; done; wait "${SDTD_PID}"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password players need to join. Leave empty for an open server.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Most players that can be connected at once.

variables.name: Visibility
variables.description: 2 lists the server publicly, 1 shows it to Steam friends only, 0 hides it.

variables.name: World
variables.description: World to play: Navezgane, one of the shipped pregenerated worlds (for example 'Pregen06k01'), or RWG to generate a random world from the seed and size below.

variables.name: Random World Seed
variables.description: Seed of the random world. Only used when World is RWG.

variables.name: Random World Size
variables.description: Size of the random world. Only used when World is RWG. Larger worlds take much longer to generate and need more memory.

variables.name: Save Name
variables.description: Name of the save game. Changing it starts a new save and keeps the old one.

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: 0 is the easiest and 5 the hardest.

variables.name: Disabled Network Protocols
variables.description: Network protocols the server does not offer, separated by commas: LiteNetLib, SteamNetworking. Servers with their ports reachable from the internet should disable SteamNetworking.

variables.name: Telnet Port
variables.description: Port of the telnet console. It carries the panel's console inside the container, has no password and is not published.

variables.name: Beta Branch
variables.description: Steam branch to install instead of the public one, for example 'latest_experimental'. Leave empty for the public branch. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Steam app id of the dedicated server. The installer and the update check on start both use it.

variables.name: Automatic Updates
variables.description: Check Steam for a game update every time the server starts.
